name: Railway OG social card — 'Ship Without Friction' by railway.com
description: A 1200×630 social card on a near-black canvas with a faint dot-grid texture. The composition splits into two zones: a static type block on the left (small wordmark lockup top-left, a three-line all-caps heavy headline anchored bottom-left) and a dynamic product visual on the right two-thirds — isometric service cards (backend, frontend, redis, postgres) connected by glowing purple deployment lines that bleed off the canvas edges. It works because of that diagonal tension between quiet typography and a cropped, depth-cued product render, with colour discipline: white type, muted greys, purple glow as the only loud accent plus tiny green status checks.
